class.name: MotionBricksPipeline
class.brief_description: Loaded motion-bricks bundle, kept resident so agents / commands / styles reuse the model.
class.description: Holds the [code skip-lint]mb_model[/code] handle so downstream agents, styles and commands reuse the loaded weights instead of paying [code skip-lint]mb_model_load[/code] per creation. This rung exposes model-level introspection only (joint layout, parameter count); agent lifecycle wrapping is a later rung.

method.name: load
method.description: Load the motion-bricks bundle directory. Required key [code skip-lint]bundle_directory[/code]. Optional keys: [code skip-lint]threads[/code], [code skip-lint]device[/code] (0 auto, 1 CPU, 2 Vulkan).

method.name: is_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [method load] has succeeded and [method unload] has not been called since.

method.name: unload
method.description: Release the loaded model. Safe to call more than once. The destructor also calls this.

method.name: get_parameter_count
method.description: Returns the number of learned parameters in the loaded model. Zero when not loaded.

method.name: get_joint_count
method.description: Returns the number of joints in the loaded model's skeleton. Zero when not loaded.

method.name: get_joint_name
method.description: Returns the name of the given joint. Empty on failure or when not loaded.

method.name: get_joint_parent
method.description: Returns the parent joint index, or [code]-1[/code] if the joint is a root or on failure.
